title: Starship Fabulous
author: Emery Joyce, Ayse Gursoy, and Chris Johnston

archive.primary: Starship Fabulous_ The Great Space Alien Dating Sim.html

description:
In Starship Fabulous: The Great Space Alien Dating Sim, you are a space marine, assigned to a trade vessel as they travel through dangerous space. But space is boring, so you decide to get to know the alien crew...

Also contains deadly glitter cannons and space pirates.

This game was made in one day for the QUILTBAG Game Jam at MIT.
